query:
SELECT TO_CHAR(block_timestamp AT TIME ZONE $2, $3) AS "bucket!",
               SUM(CASE WHEN usd_value > 0 AND usd_value <= $4 AND amount_xor <= $5 THEN usd_value ELSE 0 END) AS "total_usd: BigDecimal"
        FROM sm.fees
        WHERE block_timestamp >= $1
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1 ASC
